architecture.name: EEGNet
architecture.description: 8 temporal filters, depth multiplier 2, separable convolution; dropout 0.25

contract.filter: notch50Q30; butter4 0.5-45; elliptic AA wp100 ws128 ripple0.1dB stop80dB; causal SOS
contract.window_boundary: half-open 5120 raw samples; no gap or path mixing
contract.calibration: first pre-task arrived QC-valid complete windows only; frozen before task; no classifier adaptation

eegnet/fixed_seed42.initialization: random; no public or old-project weights

training.selection: validation P0 path BACC at raw probability threshold 0.5
training.weighting: equal valid path contribution within class; equal class total

eegnet/fixed_seed42.window_label_note: weak path labels; windows are not instantaneous symptom ground truth; temperature is fitted at path level
eegnet/fixed_seed42.evaluation_boundary: development dataset; not untouched independent testing

publication_policy.aggregation: mean of valid-window temperature-scaled high probabilities
